# usealltools.com

> usealltools.com (https://www.usealltools.com) is an open-source, privacy-first web utility suite and technical knowledge base. Every calculator, converter, generator, and validator runs 100% client-side inside the user's browser using JavaScript, Web Workers, and the Web Cryptography API. Zero data, sensitive inputs, financial numbers, or passwords are ever stored or transmitted to external servers.

usealltools.com is engineered with Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, and shadcn/ui. The project is licensed under the MIT License and actively maintained on GitHub at https://github.com/Uniquearjav/anantastra.

## Core Privacy & Security Principles

- **Zero-Telemetry Guarantee**: All computations execute locally on the client thread. No remote API requests or server logging for user data.
- **Auditable Open Source**: Every tool implementation is public, transparent, and auditable on GitHub (MIT License).
- **Zero Third-Party Trackers**: No intrusive tracking scripts, bloated ad networks, or user profiling cookies.
- **Cryptographic Rigor**: Password generation uses CSPRNG (`window.crypto.getRandomValues()`) rather than pseudo-random functions (`Math.random()`), eliminating modulo bias.
- **Offline Capable**: Once loaded into browser cache, utilities function without an active internet connection.

## Interactive Web Utilities & Calculators (36 Tools)

### Interactive Financial Calculators
- [Income Tax Calculator (FY 2025-26 & FY 2024-25)](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/calculator/income-tax-calculator): Indian income tax comparison engine between Old and New Tax Regimes (Section 115BAC). Evaluates the ₹75,000 standard deduction, Section 87A rebate up to ₹7.75 Lakhs, marginal relief formulas, and 80C/80D/HRA deductions.
- [GST Calculator (Inclusive & Exclusive)](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/calculator/gst-calculator): Dual-mode Goods and Services Tax calculator for 0%, 5%, 12%, 18%, 28%, and custom rates. Computes CGST, SGST, IGST, base prices, and reverse tax extractions.
- [Loan EMI Calculator & Amortization](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/calculator/loan-emi-calculator): Equated Monthly Installment calculator for home, car, and personal loans using standard reducing-balance annuity amortization schedules with monthly and yearly principal/interest breakdowns. (Alias: https://www.usealltools.com/loan-emi-calculator)
- [SIP Wealth & Compounding Calculator](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/calculator/sip-calculator): Systematic Investment Plan compound interest projection engine calculating total invested capital, wealth gain, and inflation-adjusted maturity corpus.
- [Interest Calculator (Simple vs Compound)](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/calculator/interest-calculator): Comparative interest analysis engine supporting daily, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and annual compounding schedules alongside linear simple interest models. (Alias: https://www.usealltools.com/interest-calculator)
- [Currency Exchange Converter](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/converters/currency-converter): Multi-currency foreign exchange calculator covering 160+ fiat currencies with offline caching capability.
- [Number to Words Converter](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/converters/number-words-converter): Converts numbers to English words in Indian numbering format (Lakhs, Crores) and International format (Millions, Billions) with bank cheque formatting ("Rupees ... Only").

### Developer, Code & Text Utilities
- [QR Code Generator & Styler](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/code-text-tools/qr-code-generator): Generates customized high-contrast QR codes for URLs, Wi-Fi networks, contacts, emails, and SMS with SVG/PNG exports and zero telemetry.
- [UUID / GUID & NanoID Generator](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/code-text-tools/uuid-generator): Bulk CSPRNG generator for UUID v4, v1, and 21-character NanoIDs with custom uppercase/lowercase formatting, braces, quotes, and JSON export.
- [Base64 Encoder & Decoder](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/converters/base64-encoder-decoder): Dual text and image converter supporting UTF-8 emoji strings, URL-safe Base64, and image Data URIs with HTML/CSS snippet generation.
- [CSS Glassmorphism Generator](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/code-text-tools/css-glassmorphism-generator): Modern frosted-glass card designer with real-time blur, opacity, border, and elevation sliders. Exports to pure CSS, Tailwind CSS, or React styles.
- [RegEx Tester & Pattern Library](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/code-text-tools/regex-tester): Interactive JavaScript regular expression evaluator with real-time match highlighting, capture group inspectors, substitution tester, and common regex presets.
- [Word Counter & Readability Analyzer](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/code-text-tools/word-counter): Live text analysis calculating words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, reading/speaking time, Flesch Reading Ease scores, and keyword density.
- [Campaign URL & UTM Builder](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/code-text-tools/utm-builder): Digital marketing tracking link generator for Google Analytics 4 (GA4) with platform presets and query string breakdown.
- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/checkers/json-formatter): Secure, client-side JSON parser, validator, minifier, and interactive tree visualizer. Ensures sensitive API credentials, tokens, and customer payloads never leave browser memory.
- [Text Difference & Diff Checker](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/code-text-tools/text-difference): Visual character, word, and line diff tool powered by the Myers Diff and Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) algorithms.
- [Markdown to HTML Live Converter](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/converters/markdown-html-converter): Real-time GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM) editor with live HTML preview, table generation, and clean HTML code extraction.
- [SVG to PNG/WebP High-Res Converter](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/converters/svg-converter): In-browser vector rasterizer using HTML5 Canvas supporting 1x, 2x, and 4x retina export without quality degradation.
- [Google SERP Simulator & Snippet Preview](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/code-text-tools/google-serp-preview): Desktop and mobile Google search snippet preview tool calculating pixel width for titles (600px cap) and meta description truncation limits (960px / 160 chars).
- [On-Page SEO Article & Content Quality Analyzer](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/code-text-tools/seo-article-analyzer): Real-time content audit tool evaluating word counts, reading times, keyword density, heading distribution (H1-H4), and Flesch Reading Ease scores.
- [Text & String Utilities Suite](https://www.usealltools.com/text): All-in-one text manipulation workstation featuring word/character counting, UPPERCASE/lowercase/Title Case transformations, whitespace stripping, and regex find-and-replace.

### Checkers, Validators & Security Tools
- [WCAG Color Contrast Checker](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/checkers/color-contrast-checker): Calculates exact relative luminance contrast ratios for text and UI components against WCAG 2.1 AA and AAA standards with live simulation.
- [Cryptographic Hash & Checksum Generator](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/checkers/hash-generator): Hardware-accelerated WebCrypto client-side hashing computing SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-384, and SHA-1 for text or dropped files with integrity verification.
- [Unix Timestamp & Epoch Converter](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/converters/unix-timestamp-converter): Real-time ticking Unix epoch clock with two-way conversion between timestamps and human dates (UTC, Local, ISO 8601).
- [Cryptographic Password Generator](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/password-tools/password-generator): Generates high-entropy passwords, Diceware passphrases, and PINs using `crypto.getRandomValues()` with real-time Shannon entropy (bits) and crack-time metrics against GPU clusters. (Alias: https://www.usealltools.com/password-generator)
- [Password Age & Credential Lifecycle Checker](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/password-tools/password-age-checker): Credential hygiene auditing utility based on NIST SP 800-63B standards to evaluate rotation cycles without storing or transmitting passwords. (Alias: https://www.usealltools.com/password-age-checker)
- [Prime Number Checker & Factorizer](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/checkers/prime-checker): High-speed primality testing engine combining 6k +/- 1 trial division with the Miller-Rabin probabilistic algorithm for prime factorization and adjacent twin prime discovery. (Alias: https://www.usealltools.com/prime-checker)
- [Palindrome Symmetry Checker](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/checkers/palindrome-checker): Two-pointer linguistic and numeric palindrome verifier with character frequency metrics and nearest palindromic distance.
- [Leap Year Calendar Checker](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/checkers/leap-year-checker): Gregorian calendar validator demonstrating the 400-year exception rule (why 2000 was a leap year but 1900 and 2100 are common years).
- [Arbitrary Precision Factorial Calculator](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/calculator/factorial-calculator): Exact factorial ($n!$), permutation ($P(n,r)$), and combination ($C(n,r)$) calculator utilizing JavaScript `BigInt` without floating-point overflow up to 10,000!.
- [Decimal, Binary & Hexadecimal Calculator](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/calculator/decimal-binary-calculator): Multi-radix converter for Base 2, Base 8, Base 10, and Base 16 numbers with signed Two's Complement representation and bitwise operations.
- [WHO Standard BMI Calculator](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/calculator/bmi-calculator): Body Mass Index calculator evaluating metric and imperial weight categories, healthy weight targets, and WHO obesity classification.
- [Chronological Age & Biological Milestones](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/calculator/age-calculator): Chronological age calculation down to years, months, days, and seconds, with biological estimations for lifetime heartbeats (~75 bpm) and breaths (~16 bpm).
- [Physical Multi-Unit Converter](https://www.usealltools.com/tools/converters/unit-converter): Multi-unit physical dimension converter covering length, mass, temperature, digital storage (decimal GB vs binary GiB), volume, area, and speed.

### Personal Finance, Taxation & Wealth Management
1. [New vs Old Tax Regime FY 2025-26 Guide](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/new-vs-old-tax-regime-fy-2025-26): Comprehensive comparison of Indian tax slabs, standard deduction increase to ₹75,000, Section 87A rebate up to ₹7.75 Lakhs, and salary breakeven benchmarks.
2. [GST Calculation Guide: Inclusive vs Exclusive Formulas](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/how-to-calculate-gst-inclusive-exclusive-formula): Mathematical derivation of forward GST addition and reverse GST extraction on commercial invoices with CGST/SGST/IGST breakdown.
3. [Home Loan EMI Formula & Amortization Secrets](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/home-loan-emi-calculation-formula-amortization): Analysis of reducing-balance interest formulas, principal-to-interest ratios, and prepayment strategies to save lakhs in interest.
4. [The Power of Compounding: ₹5,000 Monthly SIP to ₹1 Crore](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/sip-calculator-compound-interest-1-crore): Step-by-step mathematical model demonstrating how disciplined monthly investments grow via compound interest over 15 to 25 years.
5. [Simple vs Compound Interest: Formulas & Real Examples](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/simple-vs-compound-interest-formula-guide): Side-by-side mathematical contrast between linear interest accumulation and exponential compounding frequencies.
6. [How to Write Numbers in Words on Cheques and Legal Invoices](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/how-to-write-numbers-in-words-cheque-rules): Formal grammatical and legal conventions for Indian banking (Lakhs/Crores) and International commerce (Millions/Billions).
7. [Currency Exchange Rates & Global Forex Markets](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/currency-exchange-rates-forex-markets-guide): Supply and demand dynamics, central bank interest rate differentials, purchasing power parity (PPP), and currency pairs.
8. [Investing Calculator: S&P 500 & VOO Compound Growth Guide](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/investing-calculator-sp500-voo-compound-growth-guide): How to model index fund returns (nominal 10% vs real 7%), tax-advantaged accounts (401k, Roth IRA), and ordinary annuity accumulation.
9. [How Long Will My Retirement Savings Last? 4% Rule & Longevity](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/how-long-will-retirement-savings-last-calculator-guide): Mathematical depletion models, the Trinity Study 4% withdrawal rule, and mitigating Sequence of Returns Risk (SRR).
10. [Georgia Paycheck Calculator (GA): Salary, State Tax & Net Pay](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/georgia-paycheck-calculator-salary-tax-deductions-guide): Georgia flat state income tax (5.39%), FICA withholdings (6.2% Social Security + 1.45% Medicare), and take-home pay optimization.

### Mathematics, Geometry & Statistics
11. [Algebra Calculator & Step-by-Step Equation Solver Guide](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/algebra-calculator-equation-solver-step-by-step-guide): Step-by-step methods for two-step equations, quadratic formula with discriminant analysis, and systems of linear equations.
12. [Pythagoras Equation Solver: Hypotenuse, Legs & Angles Guide](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/pythagoras-equation-solver-pythagorean-theorem-formula): Right triangle calculations using $a^2 + b^2 = c^2$, the carpenter's 3-4-5 rule, inverse tangent ($\tan^{-1}$) angles, and 3D Euclidean distance.
13. [Probability Calculator & Binomial Distribution Guide](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/probability-calculator-binomial-distribution-formula-guide): Bernouilli trials, combination coefficients $\binom{n}{k}$, standard deviation $\sigma = \sqrt{n p (1-p)}$, and large-number factorial handling.
14. [Cómo Sacar el Porcentaje de una Cantidad: Fórmulas y Trucos](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/como-sacar-el-porcentaje-de-una-cantidad-calculadora): Definitive percentage guide in Spanish covering commercial discounts, salary increases, tips, IVA calculations, and mental math shortcuts.
15. [TI-84 Emulator Online & Graphing Calculator Guide](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/ti-84-emulator-online-graphing-calculator-desmos-guide): Browser-based graphing emulators, Desmos vs TI-84 Plus CE comparisons, linear regression, and standardized exam testing policies.
16. [Binary, Decimal, and Hexadecimal Computing Guide](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/binary-decimal-hexadecimal-conversion-guide): Positional notation mechanics, binary bitwise logic, memory addressing in hexadecimal, and Two's Complement arithmetic.
17. [Factorials and Permutations: 52! Deck of Cards Math](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/factorials-permutations-deck-of-cards-math): The mathematics of 52 factorial ($8.0658 \times 10^{67}$), Stirling's approximation, combinatorial explosion, and cryptographic entropy.
18. [How Leap Years Work: Why 2100 is NOT a Leap Year](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/why-2100-is-not-a-leap-year-calendar-math): Solar year drift calculations (365.2422 days), Gregorian calendar reform, and the 400-year century leap exception.

### Software Engineering, Web Standards & Algorithms
19. [Why You Should Never Use Online JSON Formatters for Sensitive Data](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/why-offline-json-formatter-safer-for-developers): Security analysis of clipboard eavesdropping, server logging of API secrets, and the benefits of local browser parsing.

23. [Text Case Conventions: camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/text-case-converter-camelcase-snake-case-kebab-case): Software engineering naming conventions across JavaScript, Python, CSS, URL slugs, and database column names.
24. [Four Function Calculator & Simple Online 10-Key Simulator](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/four-function-calculator-simple-online-10-key-simulator): Anatomy of 10-key numeric keypad touch typing, immediate execution vs algebraic PEMDAS parsing, and zero-telemetry advantages.
25. [Is usealltools.com Really Open Source? Privacy Architecture](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/is-anantastra-really-open-source): Architectural breakdown of usealltools.com's zero-telemetry client-side processing, MIT license, and open-source transparency.

### Science, Healthcare & Education
26. [Healthy BMI Ranges for Men and Women](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/healthy-bmi-ranges-men-women-calculator-guide): Truth behind Body Mass Index, WHO cutoffs, limitations regarding muscle mass and athletic body composition, and body fat alternatives.
27. [What is MDCalc? Clinical Decision Support & Healthcare Scoring](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/mdcalc-clinical-calculators-medical-decision-tools-guide): Review of evidence-based clinical scoring tools (Wells' PE Criteria, CHA2DS2-VASc, GCS, MELD) and how clinical formulas differ from consumer apps.
28. [Data Storage Conversion: Why 1TB Shows as 931GB](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/why-1tb-hard-drive-shows-931gb-storage-guide): Decimal SI units ($10^{12}$ bytes) versus binary IEC units ($2^{40}$ bytes) and operating system file system accounting.
29. [The Mystery of Palindromes: From Sator Squares to DNA](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/mystery-of-palindromes-literature-to-dna): Palindromic symmetry across ancient linguistics, computer science two-pointer algorithms, and genetic restriction enzyme recognition sites.
30. [How Age Calculators Work: Precision & Biological Milestones](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/age-calculator-chronological-biological-milestones): Gregorian day counting algorithms, leap day adjustments, and estimating lifetime heartbeat and respiratory milestones.
31. [International Morse Code: Alphabet, Sound Timing, & SOS](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/international-morse-code-alphabet-sound-guide): Complete ITU timing standards (1 dit unit, 3 dah units, 7 word units), mnemonic rhythms, and maritime distress history.
32. [Morse Code Generator & CW Audio Training Techniques](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/morse-code-generator-audio-training-techniques): Practical amateur radio ear training techniques including the Koch Method, Farnsworth timing, and rhythm recognition.

### Cryptography, Passwords & Security
33. [How Long to Crack Your Password: Entropy & GPU Hash Rates](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/how-long-to-crack-password-entropy-guide): In-depth review of password entropy, Shannon equations, NTLM/bcrypt cracking speeds on modern RTX 4090 clusters, and dictionary resistance.
34. [Password Hygiene and Credential Rot: NIST SP 800-63B](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/password-age-hygiene-nist-credential-rotation): Why modern cybersecurity standards abandon arbitrary 90-day password resets in favor of length, passkeys, and threat-driven rotation.
35. [Prime Numbers in Cryptography: RSA & Banking Encryption](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/prime-numbers-cryptography-rsa-encryption): Prime factor trapdoor functions, modular arithmetic, Euler's totient function, and the role of 2048-bit primes in TLS security.
36. [QR Code Security, Privacy, and High-Contrast Design Standards](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/qr-code-generator-privacy-design-guide): Reed-Solomon error correction levels (L, M, Q, H), dynamic vs static QR risks, quishing mitigation, and SVG/PNG contrast ratios.
37. [Database Primary Keys: UUID v4 vs v7 vs NanoID Benchmark](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/uuid-v4-vs-v7-nanoid-database-primary-keys): B-Tree indexing fragmentation, CSPRNG randomness, timestamp sortability, and collision probability comparison.
38. [Client-Side SHA-256 Hashing: File Checksums & Zero-Telemetry Security](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/client-side-sha256-hashing-file-checksum-security): WebCrypto API hardware acceleration, Merkle-Damgård construction, chunked streaming for large files, and tamper detection.
39. [WCAG Color Contrast Standards: Accessible Web & UI Design Guide](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/wcag-color-contrast-accessibility-standards-web-design): Relative luminance math, 4.5:1 (AA) vs 7:1 (AAA) thresholds, dark mode ergonomics, and visual impairment simulation.
40. [The Unix Epoch, POSIX Time, and the Year 2038 Problem](https://www.usealltools.com/blog/unix-epoch-timestamp-architecture-year-2038-problem): 32-bit signed integer overflow (2,147,483,647), 64-bit migration paths, UTC leap second handling, and high-precision millisecond conversion.

## Machine-Readable & Discovery Endpoints

- [Dynamic XML Sitemap](https://www.usealltools.com/sitemap.xml): Complete, search-engine index of all tools, calculators, and articles.
- [Plain-Text Sitemap](https://www.usealltools.com/sitemap.txt): Direct line-by-line list of all canonical URLs.
- [JSON Sitemap API](https://www.usealltools.com/api/sitemap?format=json): Structured programmatic index returning paths, last modification dates, priorities, and change frequencies.
- [Robots Configuration](https://www.usealltools.com/robots.txt): Standard crawler directives permitting global indexing and referencing sitemap resources.
- [IndexNow Verification Endpoint](https://www.usealltools.com/5ffaf57c3f706928109c0e0405f6ceca.txt): Real-time search engine indexation key verifying site ownership for Bing, Yandex, Seznam, and IndexNow protocol partners.
- [Deep Technical Documentation (llms-full.txt)](https://www.usealltools.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive technical breakdown with mathematical proofs, algorithm definitions, comparison matrices, and master AEO question-answer repository.
